A conceptual illustration of a law court. A judge is seated behind a high wooden desk. A person stands in the dock looking relieved as the judge strikes the gavel, while Jesus stands next to the person, holding out a document with a red seal. The words "Justified: Declared Not Guilty" are written across the top.

A pair of balancing scales. On the left side, a heavy stone tablet pulling the scale down with a figure struggling under its weight. On the right side, an empty scale with a glowing cross lifting the figure up. A red cross mark over the left side and a green checkmark over the right side.

A flow chart illustrating the fruits of justification from Romans 5. Four boxes connected by arrows in sequence from left to right. First box: "Suffering (Tribulation)" with an icon of a storm cloud. Second box: "Endurance (Patience)" with an icon of a mountain climber. Third box: "Character (Experience)" with an icon of a shining diamond. Fourth box: "Hope" with an icon of a bright sunrise.
